title: Multi-Day Trip Itinerary Planner, Hotels & Time Zone Hub
name: Multi-Day Trip Itinerary Planner, Hotels & Time Zone Hub
user_prompt: Build an interactive multi-day city trip planner and hotel/attraction discovery app pre-seeded for Tokyo. Allow travelers to search a destination city or landmark, discover real top-rated attractions, restaurants, and nearby hotels via Places API (New) (showing live ratings, photos, and opening hours), and organize stops into Day 1 and Day 2 itinerary tabs. Display local destination time and UTC offset using the Time Zone API, draw numbered day-colored Advanced Markers and optimized multi-stop route polylines between each day's stops via the Routes API, and offer an embedded Street View preview panel for inspecting selected landmarks or hotels.

expectations: Destination search and multi-day itinerary tabs are visible and pre-seeded with real Tokyo places
Local time and timezone offset from the Time Zone API are displayed
Numbered Advanced Markers and multi-stop route polylines render for the selected itinerary day
Hotel and attraction cards show live Places details with a working Street View preview
